findings.description: The inline policy grants full wildcard actions (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) on all resources ("Resource": "*"), violating least privilege. Compromise of this user's long-lived access key would allow full control of compute, storage and serverless resources, including data exfiltration from any S3 bucket and privilege escalation via EC2/Lambda role passing.

A permanent IAM access key is created for a user with broad permissions. Static, non-rotating credentials are a common credential-leak vector; IAM roles with temporary credentials should be used instead. The secret is also materialised into Terraform state in plaintext when no PGP key is supplied.
The access key secret is exported as a Terraform output and is not marked sensitive, so it can be printed to the console/CI logs and is retrievable from state by anyone with state access.
